Question 12

The height of a conical cup is 6 cm and the opening radius is 2 cm. Water leaks out of the bottom at the rate of 2cm3/s. If the water level is 3cm at a particular moment, how fast is the water level decreasing at that moment?

a
2πcm/s
b
4πcm/s
c
πcm/s
d
2πcm/s
e
1πcm/s
